inspected_new_strategy.provenance_status: Original-facing publisher gist carries a author notice; independent identity match between account and named author not established. No mirror substituted as canonical source.

defaults.commission_or_slippage: Not specified in declaration; cannot carry zero friction into acceptance accounting
defaults.timeframe: Title identifies XAUUSD daily; code does not enforce timeframe

exact_entry.bullish: For each i=1,2,3: current body>body[i], close>close[i], open<=open[i]; counter resets on any failure, and must finish at3
exact_entry.bearish: For each i=1,2,3: current body>body[i], close<close[i], open>=open[i]; counter resets on any failure, and must finish at3
exact_entry.long: bullish AND close>EMA25 AND position_size==0 AND stoch(close,high,low,14)>70
exact_entry.short: bearish AND close<EMA25 AND position_size==0 AND stoch(close,high,low,14)<25
exact_entry.order: Market strategy.entry; both sides enabled. Entry call clears persistent stop, targets and entry reference to na.
exact_entry.distinctness: Three-bar engulfing geometry is a distinct entry premise from FullCandle single-bar wick geometry; EMA and stochastic filters remain related to prior tested families and must be disclosed, not claimed independent.

exact_exit_state.initialization: On a calculation observing an open side with stoploss na, capture that side's stop candidate; risk distance uses actual position_avg_price; targets1/2 use1R/2R; retain persistent state afterward.
exact_exit_state.breakeven: After all exit calls, if long and high>target1, set persistent stoploss to position_avg_price; if short and low<target1, same. A new price submission therefore depends on a later recalculation; this is not an immediate same-tick update proof.
exact_exit_state.partial_reservation: Requested25% then100% requires framework order reservation semantics; not two independent full notional exits.
exact_exit_state.same_ids: Both sides reuse1st exit and2nd exit IDs. The v5 reference says existing unfilled orders with matching IDs can be modified. Matching from_entry, side filtering and reservation interaction require native proof; do not silently rename IDs or drop source calls.
exact_exit_state.warmup: ATR multiplier0 does not justify removing ATR computation or NaN propagation. Undefined ATR before sufficient history can leave stop candidates na.
exact_exit_state.gap_risk: Source has no guard ensuring low[1] is below actual long fill or high[1] above actual short fill. Do not clamp invalid risk distances or rebase stops without declaring a different strategy.

framework_limits: calc_on_order_fills can perform additional historical bar calculations; current high/low, EMA and stochastic values at fill recalculation must not be treated as causal intrabar observations without an execution audit
Default ATR multiplier0 makes valid-history initial stop depend on prior bar low/high, but does not solve shared order-ID or breakeven update timing
Historical broker path and fill recalculation cannot be reproduced by simply replacing every source call with completed8h signals and next-open fills while claiming native parity
The source's1%margin settings permit leveraged native configurations; a Spot cash cap is a declared adaptation
100%available-equity sizing needs explicit fee reserve, precision, minimum size and rejected-order policy for Spot
No native runtime or fill fixtures executed here
necessary_before_any_registration: Establish canonical author identity/provenance to requested standard
Prove or explicitly declare shared exit-ID behavior without silent source repairs
Freeze causal fill recalculation, partial exit, breakeven activation and gap policies
Declare long-only cash adaptation and8h departure from daily gold context
Preserve source numeric defaults, no invented timeout or protection
